Dormeo US · Weekly Business Review · Week 43 (Oct 18–24, 2026)
Sales were $62,720, -21% vs the prior week ($79,095), on 178 units (-21%).
The drop is mostly Octaspring Queen: it sold 17 units vs 79 the week before (-78%) because it has 0 units available at FBA, with 400 inbound.
40 units were refunded this week (23.0% refund rate), vs 35 (15.6%) the week before.
Refunds land against orders from earlier weeks, so part of this is the Prime Big Deal Days volume coming back. Worth checking the return reasons for the Queen and King toppers.
Dormeo US · Weekly Business Review · Week 43 (Oct 18–24, 2026)
October is pacing to about $437.2K: $371.0K so far plus 6 days at $11.0K/day (the October daily average without the 2 event days).
Pace is -6% vs Sep. Getting the Queen topper back in stock is the biggest lever: it is the top-selling line and has been unavailable since the Prime event.

Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for the 33 Dormeo US products over the last 90 days.
That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
Turn on review tracking for Dormeo US in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so next week's deck shows star rating and review count per line.
With the refund rate at 23.0% this week, reading the newest 1–3 star reviews for the Queen and King toppers is the quickest way to see whether the returns share a cause.
